_meta.notes: Amendment to the 1-31-06 year-end report (amendment box Yes, date of report '1-31-06'; the Summary Page header reads '1-31-06 Amended'); signed 7/14/06 and clerk-stamped RECEIVED JUL 18 2006. DECIMAL-SEPARATOR CAVEAT: this filer's decimal mark is a comma-like tick, so the Column A figures are recorded verbatim with a comma (67606,85 / 34155,59 / 4735,24 / 72342,09 / 38186,50) while the Column B figures read as periods; the separator is genuinely ambiguous at 250 dpi and no value was normalized. Column A arithmetic is self-consistent, but Column B is not: 538089.87 - 499883.37 = 38206.50, which is 20.00 more than the Line 7 balance of 38186.50 (kept verbatim). Compared with the un-amended 1-31-06 report (key b7a128e9), the amendment raises Line 1 by 2,500.00 in both columns.

contributions.detail: exact (67,606.85 = 67,606.85); 91 rows across pp.4-6 (p4 32,200.00 + p5 31,200.00 + p6 4,206.85) sum to the attachment's own printed '$ 67,606.85'. Summary Page line 1 Column A prints the same figure with a DECIMAL COMMA ('67606,85'), which the totals tranche recorded verbatim - the attachment's typed '$ 67,606.85' is the unambiguous form of the same number

expenditures.detail: exact (34,155.59 = 34,155.59); 78 rows across pp.8-9 (p8 23,179.95 + p9 10,975.64) sum to the attachment's own printed '$ 34,155.59'. The two parenthesised rows MUST be treated as negative for it to close - the document's own arithmetic settles the sign. Summary Page line 2 Column A prints it with a decimal comma ('34155,59')

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The on-form schedules (p3 Schedule A, p7 Schedule B) are BLANK apart from 'See Attached List' and their SUBTOTAL/TOTAL cells are EMPTY, so no on-form gate exists. The attachments print no per-page subtotal either - only one grand total at the end of each. Gate applied there, and BOTH close to the cent: contributions 32,200.00 + 31,200.00 + 4,206.85 = 67,606.85 = printed total; expenditures 23,179.95 + 10,975.64 = 34,155.59 = printed total.
itemized.escalation_note: all five money pages were re-rendered at 220 dpi after the 100 dpi classification pass and re-read in full; both sides then closed exactly. The attachments are born-digital spreadsheet prints, so no per-cell crop was needed. pp.4-6 are landscape but poppler renders them landscape natively for this file - no rotation required.
itemized.notes: 10-page AMENDED filing (Peter Corroon, Mayor; the schedule header boxes are hand-dated '1-31-06 Amended'). p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 on-form Schedule A ('See Attached List', totals left EMPTY), pp.4-6 the contributions attachment, p7 on-form Schedule B ('See Attached List', totals EMPTY), pp.8-9 the expenditures attachment, p10 a photocopy of ONE $2,500 check (Johansen-Thackeray, memo '2005 golf classic') and its deposit ticket - a supporting exhibit, NOT a schedule, and nothing on it was transcribed. THE ATTACHMENTS PAGINATE THEMSELVES 'PAGE n OF 9' matching the PDF pages. DATE COLUMN: the attachments print a date only on the FIRST row of each date group and leave the rest blank; those rows are emitted with a BLANK date and an explicit note - the date was never carried down from the row above. IN-KIND is marked by the literal text 'In Kind' sitting IN THE DATE CELL (27 contributions and the same 27 as expenditures), which is exactly the field-shift trap the screen looks for - it is a marker, not a date. REFUNDS RUN BOTH WAYS on Schedule B: two rows are printed in ACCOUNTING PARENTHESES and are genuinely NEGATIVE (refunds received: Domain Registry -85.00, Qwest -41.68 - the total only closes when they are subtracted), while three 1/30/2006 'Refund campaign contribution' rows are POSITIVE outgoing refunds to Snowbird, Reagan Outdoor and Sinclair Oil, each matching a Schedule A row annotated 'contribution refunded see expenditures'. The COMPLETE MAILING ADDRESS column exists on the contributions attachment but prints empty on this scan (one unreadable ghost line behind the first p6 row), so no donor city/state is recorded and none was inferred. Column-A figures on the Summary Page use a DECIMAL COMMA; the attachments print the same numbers with a period, and the two agree.
